question: Which of the following teams won the Raja Bhalindra Singh trophy at the 36th National Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Raja Bhalindra Singh trophy:-**

 
 
• **Services team won the Raja Bhalindra Singh trophy at the 36th National Games.**
 
• The Raja Bhalindra Singh trophy is **awarded to the overall champion team of the National Games, which is held once in four years and is the most prestigious multi-sport event in India.**
 
• Services team is known for its strong sports culture and has consistently performed well in various national and international competitions. It has won the Raja Bhalindra Singh trophy multiple times in the past as well.
 
• Winning the Raja Bhalindra Singh trophy is a matter of great pride for any team as it signifies their overall excellence and dominance in various sports disciplines.
